submitted.rationale: Index 5 (Bi0.41 Cu0.19 V0.40) had the highest photocurrent of the three I measured: 10.6 µA. Its XRD pattern looks like monoclinic BiVO4 (peaks at Q≈1.35, 2.03 and 2.15 1/Å). Of the candidates, it has the Bi:V ratio closest to 1 with the least Cu, and BiVO4 is the known photoactive phase in this system. Index 8, which has more Bi than V, gave less photocurrent (6.1 µA). The Cu-rich, multiphase index 16 gave none.

rejected.reason: Measured 0 A. XRD shows many phases (Cu-rich).
Measured 6.1 µA, lower than index 5. It has more Bi than V.
Not measured. The zero result at Cu-rich index 16 suggests Cu-rich phases are inactive, so I spent no merit measurement there.
